chunks: What was related to me by the Sheikh — may Allah the Most High support him — from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from his father, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa and al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban — both together — from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from 'Uthman, from Udaym ibn al-Hurr: that he heard Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him) saying:
«Nothing invalidates wudu except what exits from your two lower extremities.»
He [the Imam] thus negated that anything which has not exited from the two passages can invalidate wudu.

key_terms.السَّبِيلَيْنِ: the two passages (urinary orifice and anus)
key_terms.طَرَفَيْكَ الْأَسْفَلَيْنِ: your two lower extremities (the front and back private parts)

ai.seo_question: What are the causes that invalidate wudu according to Imam al-Sadiq in Tahdhib al-Ahkam?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) issues a comprehensive ruling that wudu is invalidated solely by what exits from the two lower passages (the urinary orifice and the anus), excluding all other bodily occurrences from the category of hadath. Sheikh al-Tusi, the compiler of Tahdhib al-Ahkam, appends a clarifying juristic note affirming that the Imam's statement constitutes a general negation: nothing that does not exit from these two passages can break wudu.
